lines: The sky's CV just got updated.
Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.
The dams are doing a happy dance.
One night of proper rain and the driveway has joined the water table.
Thursday night, and the balcony has been promoted to the main room.
It is cooler out here at midnight than it was inside at six.
The ice in that jug never stood a chance and everybody knew it.
That curtain is the only moving air in the entire flat.
Nobody is going back in there until the walls let go of the day.
Ice in the jug, fan on the chair: the night shift of a forty-degree day.
The fog got to the lookout first and took the whole view for itself.
Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.
The braai is happening. The braai always happens. We just pull the chairs closer.
The temperature dropped with the sun and the circle got tighter by exactly that much.
The evening turned cold the minute it turned beautiful, which is the usual trade.
The sun is leaving the mountains one shelf at a time.
